items.text: A Brand-New Hotfix is now LIVE!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44488792/5f176167919efdc88a5a5efb568658e147572224.png"]
A quick pass before the curtain rises again, Maskless Ones. This hotfix smooths a handful of rough edges across the stage.
Fixes
Fixed a few teleport interactions not prompting correctly when approached:
Old Sanctuary (Maya statue in Vermiglio's arena)
Strale Velata (main stage curtains in the Theatre of the Masks)
Forgotten Depths (Master Gondolier gondola in the Mines of Gratia)
Fixed unlockable ladders not correctly activating after being interacted with in a previous session
Fixed a crash tied to item stat requirements
Fixed a crash linked to the weapon elemental infusion system
Fixed a few meshes showing the wrong textures
Fixed a few missing environmental collisions
Fixed an issue with the hit reaction system not working properly
Minor fixes
PS5 Only
Fixed an issue with the save system causing error CE-107101-0
Improved the save backup system to reduce save file size, helping avoid error CE-100028-1
Improved main menu loading speed

releases.displayName: Enotria: The Last Song - March Patch is LIVE

items.text: The March patch is here! Please make sure to download the update before playing the game, remember to share your feedback with us - it's time to face the eternal play!
Most weapons received a moveset update:
Common weapons now feature simpler and more straightforward movesets. The chains now differ between classes and between weapons within the same class.
Rare weapons may include new actions as well as attacks that auto-infuse the weapon with a specific element during the attack.
Epic weapons mainly introduce new moveset or a special spell within the attack chains.
Legendary weapons feature completely new moveset.
The rarity of all weapons has been adjusted to reflect these changes.
The statistics of the weapons have been better aligned with their rarity and the new actions they provide.
Ambient sounds in Falesia Magna have been updated.
New ambient sounds have been added to Litumnia.
Arlecchino has received new attack sound effects.
The immersive audio experience has been improved with an updated audio mix.
New boss fight music has been introduced for: Maja, Moretta, Gondolier, Arlecchino, and the Litumnia elite fight.
New music tracks include:
Credits music
PS5 home screen music
Updated music for:
Title Menu
Hub
Force of Change
Veltha boss fight
Pulcinella boss fight
Quinta elite fight
Falesia elite fight
Various other sound effects throughout the game have been improved.
Fixed a bug that prevented RADIANT from exploding upon hitting an enemy.
Resolved an issue where certain Xbox achievements could not be unlocked under specific circumstances.
Various bug fixes.

releases.displayName: Enotria: The Last Song - Achievements Hotfix

items.text: Great news, Maskless Ones!
A long-awaited hotfix for the achievements is now LIVE!
Best of luck on your achievement-hunting endeavours!
We are happy to announce that the 1.006 update for Enotria: The Last Song is now LIVE! Check out the latest changes like combat tweaks, animation adjustments and fixes in the patch notes below:

NEW Loadout Presets: Presets allow you to save up to 5 premade loadouts for each save slot. You can store them for later use or as a utility to transfer multiple items from one loadout to another. Presets can be accessed through the “Manage Loadout” button in the Loadouts Menu, at any Reality Knot.
PC: Presets are saved to a dedicated folder inside each Profile. You can share them or import presets from other players easily by copy-pasting the file.

A new weapon stat is now shown in menus: Average Damage. It is a unified value between Physical, Ardore, and the highest Elemental damage, to help determine the overall strength of the weapon at a glance. This stat will also help you quickly identify the Loadout Preset with the highest damage when loading a Preset.
The rarity value of the weapons is now displayed better and written in the inventory.
The weapon rarity border is now shown on the HUD too, when looting items. Rarity information has also been added in the weapon details on the right to match the borders.
The Fast Travel menu now shows which Reality Knots have an anvil for upgrading equipment nearby.
Fixed minor visual issues in the Shop menu.
Updated and unified Italian definitions for “Longsword” to “Spada Lunga” to better reflect the class.
Implemented some camera views to improve players' guidance through different areas.
The respec feature is now moved to Pulcinella instead of Veltha.
Added displayed inputs on the menu part of the initial tutorial.
Now, when you switch your active loadout, your HP will scale in percentage.
A short cutscene of Veltha has been added to give more immersion.
A slight body light has been added to the main character to improve readability in some dark areas.
Giangurgolo's phase two fight improved for a better combat experience.
HLOD has been improved slightly, and we are continuing to improve them.
The golden path and especially Litumnia guidance have been improved to help exploration.
The lighting of the whole game has been improved overall.
Improved the quality of the SFX of some gameplay elements for better feedback.
Fixed some issues with trophies that sometimes made it impossible to get the platinum.
Improved the readability of some VFX (such as Pillar, Rifts, Grenade explosion, Reality knot).
Achievements are now fixed
PS5: Improved and optimized Scalability settings: Graphics vs Performance.

releases.displayName: Enotria: The Last Song - Hotfix Patchnotes

notes.title: You can now change the Game Mode between "Story" and "Soulslike" anytime you wish during your playthrough. To do it, access the in-game Settings menu, in the Gameplay category.

items.text: This will of course be possible also on playthroughs you have already started.
We are happy to announce that the 1.005 update for Enotria: The Last Song is now LIVE! Check out the latest changes like combat tweaks, animation adjustments and fixes in the patch notes below:

Tuned the Sickness status to improve the player's experience. The "Sickness" status now deals less damage. That means that the main character and enemies can't be fully immune to the status when applied.
The percentage of health damage of "Sickness" has been reduced.

Tuned the Radiant status to improve the player's experience. It does not trigger its healing effect immediately, and the explosion is slightly delayed. Thanks to that both the enemies and the players will feel both negative and positive effects of this status. This change also helps with the issue of enemies healing while invincible after radiant was applied to them with a riposte or backstab attack
The "Radiant" premature explosion is slightly stronger.
The "Wicked" status now heals for less when the maskless one hits an enemy affected by it.
Fixed an issue that made certain boundaries not appear when starting a boss fight.
Added custom bindings for mouse and keyboard controls.

Players can now choose a difficulty level while starting a new game, you can choose between the Soulslike experience and a Story mode - the story mode is a bit easier than the original difficulty of the game. It only affects your first playthrough, as with NG+ and above the difficulty level is the same for both modes. Players who already started a run in Enotria will be playing at “Story” mode difficulty. We're working on implementing the difficulty selector on every saved game, so you can switch between Story Mode and the Soulslike Experience whenever you want.
Progression has been balanced based on the feedback we’ve received so far.
The difficulty curve of Falesia and Litumnia has been rebalanced to feature less difficulty spikes and an overall smoother experience.
Bosses and Mini-Bosses now reward less Memoria, while regular enemies have the Memoria drop amount increased. This will help players progress more smoothly throughout the game and its NG+ cycles.
NG+ difficulty has been adjusted due to the base game changes.
Enemies that were aligned with the "Gratia" element now are more "tolerant" to the "sickness" status. It will take slightly longer to apply the status against them.
Fixed an issue for which certain bosses in rare condition would be unresponsive towards the player.
Fixed an issue for which certain enemies were taking a lot more damage than intended when the maskless one would execute a riposte or backstab attack against them.
The "Priestess" in the "High priestess" boss fight now can coordinate attacks.
Improved "Veltha" hitboxes when she stomps on the ground and executes the follow-up combo.
Small crabs are no longer able to deal double damage with regular attacks.
The minimum damage dealt to the player by the enemies has been adjusted.
Certain bosses will now transition into phase 2 slightly sooner.
Nerfed the “Rock” item damage.
All weapons have now improved their attack flow.
Armonia Amber use has been speed up.

Lines charge speed has been adjusted to be faster at lower levels, thanks to that even the very slow lines should be usable from the start, but you still have to upgrade them to deal competitive damage in the late game.
“Stage” Weapons are now overall stronger to match the new balance of the game.
Corrected Lines HUD to display usability properly.
The status HUD will no longer appear after the effect ends.
Armonia’s charges will now be correctly displayed with Zanni’s Mask.
Addressed the issue with Memoria disappearing if not looted before quitting the game.
Fixed a progression lock caused by using Hymn of Return after defeating Arlecchino.
Made a combat rift in Quinta visible again.
Fixed terrain holes in Strale Velata and Litumnia City Commons where players could fall off the map.
Resolved issue where music in Quinta continued playing after defeating mobs who were playing the music.
Fixed occasional double dialogue lines.
Corrected Main Character HP bar display issue showing incorrect HP instead of 0.
Fixed the issue preventing players from choosing the second dialogue option.
Addressed a rare issue where the main character could get stuck in an elevator.
Fixed boss music stopping under certain conditions.
Corrected Balanzone’s voice overs not triggering properly.
Fixed spell volume issues preventing some spells from being heard.
Polished and fixed various cutscenes.
Veltha will no longer cause players to get stuck on a rare occasion.
Added a flawed vessel outside the tutorial area.
Adjusted animation blending to make the movement feel more natural.
Implemented various combat improvements, making it feel way smoother and seamless.
Combat animation speed has been increased, this makes the combat more dynamic while keeping the original style of the game.
Fixed many smaller bugs and issues mentioned by the players.
Fixed various crashes that may have occurred during gameplay.
Greetings maskless ones!

As we previously communicated Enotria in the full release would not support the usage of the Save Files from the demo. However due to a bug, it was possible to "continue" your journey from the demo files --> however, as we comunicated, this would completely break that save file and your progression overall. We have now made impossible for the demo save file to be used in the full game, so anyone can enjoy the proper experience from start to end without issue related to those old files that were not meant for the full release.
• Fixed some the interactibles range, as well as their interaction rotation
• Improved the visual of Rifts and Combat Rifts
• Minor Audio Fixes
• Fixed a bug that made enemies and loot respawn when quitting the game
• Fixed a bug that made you clip trough an elevator
• Fixed the clipping collision on some angle of the maps in which the maskless one could clip trough it
• Improved performance on the visual side
• Fixed rare event that cause ladder disappear
• Fixed rare crash when inventory open
• Fixed an issue for which the Final Boss would stare at the player after performing a certain sequence of action
• Fixed an issue for which the Final Boss would use a certain move way more than intended
• Fixed an issue for which certain litumnia enemies were not aggroing the player when entering their combat radius
• Minor fixes to animations and locomotions of characters
Fixed a bug that made some AI stuck after executing a mid air attack on rare cirucumstances
The final boss has been adjusted to improve its fighting ability overall and fixed an issue for which he had no damage reduction at all
Maskless Ones, we're thrilled to announce that the Demo Update for Enotria: The Last Song is now LIVE!
Please remember to remove your save file and start a new game after downloading this patch, not doing so may cause bugs and issues that will appear only due to save file version mismatch
It is now possible to compare items when equipping in the Loadouts Menu.
Added an indicator to empty slots when an item is available for equip.
Updated Stats highlights in the Character Menu to make them more relevant to each Virtue. Stats that are slightly increased by all Virtues are now not highlighted.
Updated the UI feedback when an item does not meet the equip requirements.
Improved blending for attack animations.
Significantly improved the blending from regular to riposte and backstab attack and responses in both animation and visual aspects.
AI combat areas and reaction to player position are improved both in and out of combat.
The player regains control of the camera sooner when executing a riposte or backstab attack.
Fixed a bug that made it impossible for Vermiglio to get backstabbed (reminder: In Enotria, backstabs are only possible after unraveling an enemy).
The two Crushing Laughters of that combat rift now have a different AI that significantly improves the 2 vs 1 situation, and their HP and damage are being appropriately tuned for the encounter.

Auto crafting: whenever the Maskless One has collected enough mask shards, the mask is crafted AUTOMATICALLY. From that point onward, additional shards of the same type are automatically sold, resulting in the player gaining extra memoria.

Auto looting: items found in the world or dropped by enemies are now automatically collected when the player goes near them - you still need to manually collect loots from chests. The feature is enabled by default but can be turned off in the options menu.
Miscellaneous fixes on performances and other bugs.
Fixes on the cloth of some characters.
There might be some problems with the audio in this patch - our team is aware of that and we're working on a fix
